title: Adding SKU and product limit to Promotion API
breadcrumb: Adding SKU and product limit to Promotion API
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2024-08-01
html:
What is changing?

When using Update Activity Product and Remove Activity Product endpoints, a list of product_id and sku_id parameters is passed to determine which products and SKUs are updated or removed for certain promotional activity. Starting from August 21, 2024, we will enforce a limit of 300 SKUs and 300 products per API call for these two endpoints. Any API calls that exceed this limit will fail and return a specific error code "17029046".

Which markets are affected?

The update applies to the local and cross-border sellers in ALL the markets

Who is affected?

Developers with applications that use Update Activity Product and Remove Activity Product

Which version is applicable?

The limits apply to all versions of the related APIs

What action is required?

Please ensure your usage complies with this new limit to avoid disruptions in service.
